literal: Firmness having known, greatness it will yield; knowledge having known, in the proper way to be restrained if achieved.
translation: If one learns what is to be known and achieves self-restraint in the proper way, that firmness will be recognized and bring them greatness.
modern: அறிய வேண்டியவற்றை அறிந்து, நல்வழியில் அடக்கத்துடன் நடந்தால், அந்த அடக்கத்தை உலகம் அறிந்து பெருமை தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the reward of disciplined self-restraint. It states that one must first acquire true knowledge and then apply it to restrain oneself in the righteous path. When a person achieves this, their steadfastness is recognized by the world, which in turn brings them immense greatness and respect.
